name: Indiginus The Banjo
help: Indiginus The Banjo. We turn the Picker and Strummer off (D0, A0) at every pass and play our own rolls; velocity zones High OFF, Low Mute; Exp CC11 amount up; Harmony off; Master Key = the song's key. Ornament keys stay off until the D0 test is run: write the keyswitch test, play it, and set "articulationReturn" (hold, or latch: returns with C1 Sustain, 36). Never use the sustain pedal on this one (it latches the Picker). Narrow "range" to the keys Kontakt colours as playable.
